name: STRATEGY_CARD_LEVELS_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: STRATEGY_CARD_LEVELS_20261107 — LQ-20261107-57. A strategy card carries a level only when
the level is on the correct side of the price and of the level it depends on (stop < entry < price
< target, support < resistance, R/R > 0); otherwise the level is NULL with a named reason and the
card is flagged needs_iteration. Measured on the live table 2026-11-07: 319 cards served
support == resistance == price, 20 served a stop at or above the price, 2 (FLTR, FFLX) served a
negative R/R. Registered because a new pytest file that no gate names is not run by CI
